description: Figure 15: Token Ratio (TR). The bar chart shows the Token Ratio (TR) of RedWhale (our) compared to EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base) across five different tasks. The tasks are PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, and KoBEST-SN. The Token Ratio (TR) is a measure of the efficiency of the tokenizer, with a lower TR indicating a more efficient tokenizer. The RedWhale (our) tokenizer has a lower TR across all tasks, indicating it is more efficient than the other two tokenizers. The average TR of the RedWhale (our) tokenizer is 0.57, which is a 50% reduction in token count compared to the base tokenizer. This reduction in token count offers several advantages, including a linear decrease in the number of inputs to the model, the ability to process longer input texts within the fixed context length of the model, and faster processing of input data due to the reduced number of tokens. The RedWhale (our) tokenizer was adapted for the Korean language, resulting in this average TR of 0.57 across five datasets, including the pretraining evaluation set and four related tasks on KoBEST. This adaptation led to a 50% reduction in token count, the capability to handle sequences over four times longer on the same hardware, and a faster training and inference relative to the base model.
